description: 带沥水槽的肥皂盒，底部排水孔
description_en: Soap dish with drainage slots and bottom holes
code:
import cadquery as cq

# === 参数 ===
length = 100     # 长 (mm)
width = 70       # 宽 (mm)
height = 20      # 高 (mm)
wall = 2         # 壁厚 (mm)
hole_d = 5       # 排水孔直径 (mm)

# === 外盒抽壳 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(length, width, height, centered=(True, True, False))
    .faces(">Z").shell(-wall)
)

# === 底部排水孔阵列 ===
result = (
    result.faces("<Z").workplane(centerOption="CenterOfBoundBox")
    .rarray(20, 20, 4, 3)
    .hole(hole_d)
)

result = result.edges("|Z").fillet(4)

show_object(result)
